kb.title: Service recovery & goodwill points
kb.body: Agents may add up to 1,000 goodwill points ($10) per case without approval. 1,001–5,000 points needs a team lead. Above that, the customer care manager.

kb.title: Fresh quality guarantee
kb.body: Perishables that fail before the best-by date are refunded or replaced. No product return needed; a photo is enough for online orders.

kb.title: Refunds and approval limits
kb.body: Agents can refund up to $50 per case to the original tender. $50–$250 needs a team lead. Card refunds take 3–5 business days; SNAP EBT refunds go back to the EBT card.

kb.title: Online order issues (late, missing, wrong substitution)
kb.body: Late outside the slot: refund the delivery/pickup fee. Missing items: refund at the price paid. Wrong substitution: refund the substitute; the customer keeps it.

kb.title: Lost & found
kb.body: Items are logged at the service desk and held 30 days (IDs, cards and phones go to the store manager's safe). Release with photo ID only.

kb.title: Loyalty points rules
kb.body: 1 point per $1 (Silver 1.25×, Gold 1.5×). Points post when the order is paid. Points expire 12 months after the last activity. 1,000 points = $5 (redeemable in blocks of 1,000).

kb.title: Warranty and extended protection
kb.body: Manufacturer warranty (usually 12 months) is handled in store by exchange within 30 days, then by warranty claim. Extended protection plans are administered by the plan provider.

kb.title: Product recalls
kb.body: Check the lot/best-by on the recall notice. Matching items are refunded in full, no receipt or return needed. Members who bought the lot are contacted automatically.

kb.title: Returns without a receipt
kb.body: Look up the purchase by member ID or card. If not found: store credit only, max $75 per day, photo ID recorded.

kb.title: Price match & promo not applied
kb.body: If a promo didn't apply at the till, refund the difference. We don't match competitor prices.
